_doc: Latency budgets (docs/spec.md, Speed and Measurement). warm_ms: local Postgres on a warm boot; remote_ms: a remote database (null = 1 RTT + 10 ms, measured per run). Read by latency-proof.sh (via latency-ledger.mjs) and latency-browser-proof.mjs. enforced_from: from this phase on a regression fails the gate: a metric more than 25% + 15 ms slower than scripts/baselines/reference-<platform>-<app|browser>.json, or over a budget the reference met (scripts/lib/latency-judge.mjs); misses the reference already has are reported, not failed.

socket_warm_vs_webview_ready.what: socket-warm − webview-ready: the socket is warm before the webview is ready

first_frame.what: first-frame − run-sent, ⌘↵ on a warm session (median)

first_frame_painted.what: first-frame-painted − run-sent (median); informational until the frame path lands

window_switch.what: window switch → new window painted (UI thread)

keystroke_5000.what: editor keystroke → highlight committed, 5,000-line text (UI thread, median)

scroll_frame_40col.what: longest scroll step of a 40-column, 5,000-row result: scroll → React commit + layout (UI thread)
